description: Audit streams of confidential ring transfers, one case per layout: dense, exits, escrow and exits_escrow at capacity 8, pair_exits at capacity 2, quad_escrow at capacity 4, and in_proof with an input named by its prefix. Hex strings are big-endian, fields 32 bytes. Fixed inputs: tx_viewing_sk is the clamped X25519 transaction secret and tx_viewing_u its public key, salt, first_nullifier n0, ring_id = hash_bytes(ring_program_id), blinding_seed = Poseidon(CRBS, pack_be(tx_viewing_sk), salt), seed_out = Poseidon(TXOS, n0, blinding_seed), output_tree_id. layout is the statement's flag value key_escrow << 1 | full_openings << 3, exits_bitmap alone records exits. Per slot: owner_key is a raw Solana key whose owner identity is hash_bytes(0x53 || owner_key), nullifier_pk, asset = hash_bytes(asset_address), amount, data_hash, ring_data_hash, owner_tag is the published owner tag. Every slot has blinding = Poseidon(TXOB, n0, seed_out, i). output_hash is the SPP UTXO hash under output_tree_id, owner Poseidon(owner identity, nullifier_pk), ring id ring_id on a ring output and 0 on an exit, a dummy hashes under the dummy domain with zero fields. A ring output has slot_secret = Poseidon(CRDS, pack_be(X25519(tx_viewing_sk, recipient_u)), pack_be(0x04 || tx_viewing_u), pack_be(0x04 || recipient_u), salt, i, n0) and body = AES-256-CTR(body_plaintext) under the CRING/bdy1 stream of slot_secret from counter 2. body_plaintext = be32(blinding) || u64be(amount) || owner_key || be32(nullifier_pk), the last field omitted under key_escrow. A dummy's owner tag and body are random bytes of the same length. stream: eph_sk, eph_u and auditor_u root secret = Poseidon(CR_S, pack_be(dh), pack_be(0x04 || eph_u), pack_be(0x04 || auditor_u)) under the CRING/adt1 schedule. envelope_plaintext = tx_viewing_sk || evidence, at counter 2, prefix16 of each published input on the in-proof rail. An exit has record_plaintext = be32(asset) || u64be(amount) || be32(nullifier_pk), the last field omitted under key_escrow, at record_counter = R0 + i * R. message = 0x04 || eph_u || envelope || records in slot order. digest = Poseidon(u32 len(envelope), HashChain4(pack_left31(envelope))) is the statement's head element 9. Generated by sdk-libs/client/tests/disclosure_vectors.rs.
